name: David Roe
bio: A Representative from Tennessee; born in Clarksville, Montgomery County, Tenn., July 21, 1945; B.S., Austin Peay State University, Clarksville, Tenn., 1967; M.D., University of Tennessee, Memphis, Tenn., 1970; United States Army, 1973-1974; physician; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Tenth Congress in 2006; member of the Johnson City, Tenn., board of commissioners, 2003-2008; vice mayor of Johnson City, Tenn., 2003-2007; Mayor of Johnson City, Tenn., 2007-2009; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eleventh and to the five succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2009-January 3, 2021); chair, Committee on Veterans' Affairs (One Hundred Fifteenth Congress); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Seventeenth Congress in 2020.
